name: Meenakshi Mohan

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Meenakshi Mohan is a Maryland-based poet, educator, painter and children’s writer. Her literary work brings together an interest in visual art, learning and the lives of families. Her books include the poetry collection Symphonies of Life and the children’s books The Gift and The Rainbow in My Room. Matwaala’s author profile also records her editorial work with Inquiry in Education and Confluence.

In Kabita Live’s ‘Waiting’, evening becomes a landscape of prayer: saffron light, trees imagined as monks, and the distant sound of a conch lead towards a small light in a window. The closing images of a mother and a wife give the quiet scene its human centre. The poem allows hope and uncertainty to remain together, without resolving the wait.
